properties.notes: This is a former depot site in Brierfield. The previous Outline planning permission has now expired. The site has been marketed for residential development. The site has been submitted to the Council's call for sites consultation and there may be interest in bringing the site forward in the future. The owner of the site has not returned the Housing Land Survey form and it is unclear when the site will come forward.
